senses.en_definition: A trace or mark left behind, such as a stain, footprint, or scar.
Former; having previously held a particular position, role, or status.
A container for holding or storing something.
A lasting effect or impression left by an event or experience.

messages.en: My old boss wants to meet up for coffee tomorrow. Want to come along?
Ms Salmah? I haven't seen her in ages. Where are you meeting?
Yep, that's her. At the café next to our old office, at three. Come along! She was asking about you too.

senses.en_definition: To carry out tasks or activities to produce or accomplish something.
To have a job or engage in an occupation to earn a living.
To attend one's workplace and carry out one's duties.

messages.en: We're planning to go to Melaka tomorrow. Can you come along?
Can't make it. I've got to work tomorrow. My boss changed the rota.
Oh no, I thought you had the day off. No worries, we'll ask you again next time.

collocations.en: work together to make the event a success

messages.en: If we work together, we'll get this done in no time. Which part do you want to do?
I'll just do the slides, okay? You've already gathered the material, right?

senses.en_definition: To acquire knowledge or understanding through study.
To acquire a skill through training or practice.

messages.en: Want to study together tonight? I still don't understand the chapter on fractions.
Sure. Bring along the question you're stuck on, and we'll try to work through it together.
Eight at the library, okay? I'll get there a bit early.
